dedupe_keys.name: code for urban expansion is coupling heat and flood exposure in cities worldwide

description: The urban heat-and-flood study authors publish Python scripts for city-year exposure accounting. Zenodo supplies twenty-five source and documentation files free under the MIT licence. Its README describes input tables for city-year metrics, event windows, city inclusion, validation and negative controls, with scripts to generate exposure summaries, robustness tables, figures and checksums. Public-product export templates cover Earth Engine and ERA5 sources. These functions can support cross-city climate-exposure comparisons used in urban-infrastructure risk simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this analysis code. Coverage depends on prepared input tables, which the companion Zenodo release describes as required but does not itself provide in the current public inventory. Source export templates also need project assets and accounts. Therefore full-paper reproduction is unverified. No script was executed or climate dataset downloaded.
